subject: PO: Acme Tools onboarding — ledger tagging & line-item disambiguation
messages:
From: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@acmetools.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmetools.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: PO number + spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Acme Tools onboarded. We need a Purchase Order to move forward with kick-off and to route the initial invoices. Attached is the current SOW and a CSV with the line items we intend to invoice for the first 90 days. Quick asks: 

- Can Redwood issue a PO number tied to the billing entity shown on page 1 of the SOW ("Acme Tools Co.", Tax ID: 98-7654321)?
- Can you confirm the initial spend cap you will place on the onboarding PO (we expect ~$75k but would like headroom)?
- There are two bundled rows in the CSV under "Implementation Services" — we can split them if Redwood prefers discrete SKUs for milestones.

Attached: Acme_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW), line_items.csv (stub)

If it helps, Marta (cc'd) will own the invoicing cadence and can provide a sample invoice. Let me know what you need from our side to get the PO issued.

Best,
Evan Shaw
Sr. Finance Manager
Acme Tools Co.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@acmetools.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number + spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Evan — thanks for the SOW and the CSV. Welcome aboard.

Karthik / Olga — looping you in to action the PO issuance and verify accounting codes. Evan: two quick clarifications before we issue a provisional PO number:

- Confirm billing entity: we will use "Acme Tools Co." and Tax ID 98-7654321 as shown?
- Please confirm whether you want the two "Implementation Services" lines split into separate SKUs (we prefer separate lines for milestone tracking).

Karthik: can you provision a PO (provisional OK) and assign a ledger tag for Acme? If you need a placeholder spend cap, suggest we start with $75,000/month pending ramp. Olga: can you confirm what ledger code we should use and whether procurement requires any additional documentation for a $75k monthly cap?

Evan — if you anticipate ramp beyond $75k in the first 60 days, please indicate the rate so we can consider a higher provisional cap.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@acmetools.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmetools.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number + spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Monica — thanks for the quick loop. Confirmations below and attaching a slightly revised SOW reflecting a two‑milestone split.

- Billing entity: confirmed "Acme Tools Co."; Tax ID 98-7654321.
- Yes, please split the Implementation Services into two SKUs: "Implementation — Planning" and "Implementation — Execution". That will align with our internal milestones and invoices.
- Regarding spend cap: we expect an initial month of heavier activity. Can Redwood provisionally set the spend cap to $90,000 for month one and then step down to $60,000/month after the initial phase (month 2+)? If not possible, we can keep $75,000 and queue a formal cap increase request.

Attached: Acme_SOW_v3.pdf (updated), line_items.csv (updated with split rows)

Quote from earlier in thread: 
On Fri, Dec 18, 2026 at 10:03 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Karthik / Olga — looping you in to action the PO issuance and verify accounting codes.

Thanks and let me know what you need to complete issuance.

Best,
Evan

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: PO number + spend cap confirmation for onboarding (internal)

Karthik / Olga — internal action items and decision: 

1) PO issuance: please create a provisional PO number PO-ACME-342 tied to Acme Tools Co. (Tax ID 98-7654321). Set the ledger tag "ACME_ONB_2026".
2) Spend cap: vendor requests $90,000 for month 1, then $60,000/month thereafter. I am comfortable approving provisional $90k for month 1 given expected ramp; after month 1 we should auto-adjust to $60k unless vendor submits a formal cap increase request with justification.
3) Line items: vendor provided split SKUs — we need to map the two Implementation lines into separate ledger lines and ensure we store milestone dates. Karthik, update the PO line items to: 
   - Implementation — Planning (SKU: ACME-INS-P) — start 2027-01-04; end 2027-01-18
   - Implementation — Execution (SKU: ACME-INS-E) — start 2027-01-19; end 2027-02-28
   - License (SKU: ACME-LIC) — recurring monthly
4) Attachments: line_items.csv should be uploaded to the onboarding folder and linked to the PO. Olga, please confirm accounting code and whether we need a signed EDI or additional docs for a $90k provisional cap.

Please mark status when PO number is created and provide the PO PDF so I can send it back to the vendor. If you run into any procurement gating rules (special approvals at $90k), escalate to me immediately.

Thanks — Monica

--
